protocol.protocol_change: No effective-batch change: world2/B2/A2/K19 and 152-pair loss are preserved. A direct K19 decoder forward exceeds 47.37-GiB devices, so each microbatch's fixed targets are executed as deterministic 10+9 forwards and weighted 10/19+9/19.

gradient_shard_layout_rank0.storage: rank-local host-memory FP32 snapshots; zero_grad(set_to_none=True) after capture

kubric.prompt: Estimate dense three-dimensional point trajectories over time from this monocular video. The video shows multiple rigid objects moving independently in a rendered three-dimensional scene. The camera viewpoint may change over time, and objects may become occluded and reappear.

pointodyssey.prompt: Estimate dense three-dimensional point trajectories over time from this monocular video. The video shows articulated characters and objects undergoing diverse rigid and non-rigid motion in a rendered three-dimensional scene. The camera viewpoint may change over time, and objects may become occluded and reappear.

dynamic_replica.prompt: Estimate dense three-dimensional point trajectories over time from this monocular video. The video shows articulated people moving through a rendered furnished indoor three-dimensional scene. The camera viewpoint may change over time, and people may become occluded and reappear.
